items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I’m starting this Latin jazz thing, would you like to play?” Boom. And we did many gigs together.

ctx.x: Okay. Got the corner staked out?

No I think the future is to continue to play and explore my possibilities as much as I can, and write music and get to meet more and more musicians and play in different contexts with the music. Like I just was with McCoy Tyner, which was a great experience to play with recording, he was doing a Latin jazz thing. He called me, I says, “Hello?” “Yeah, Dave?” “Yes.” “This is McCoy Tyner.” “Yeah, right. Stop messing around, who’s this? “It’s McCoy Tyner.” “Really?” “Yeah.” I’m starting this Latin jazz thing, would…
I overheard you telling a humorous story about him at the Grammy awards.
